title: Anniversary Balloons
body:
Pretty balloons, with many different colors! I bet these would go GREAT at a party.

This item celebrates Oaklands' Release Anniversary! Thank you for your support. ❤

Anniversary Balloons are a limited-time object that can be bought at The Oak Depot for $250. It is a multicolored set of balloons attached to a black block

Details

The Anniversary Balloons are only available for two weeks.

This item is functionally identical to the Halloween Balloons.
